prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup background texture.
Create ONE square flat 2D background texture for a Japanese Sengoku-era tabletop wargame counter. It is a BACKGROUND ONLY asset to be used underneath exact digital typography. No characters, no soldiers, no weapons, no figures, no houses, no landscape scenes, no writing, no kanji, no numbers, no border, no lines, no frame, no arrow, no grid, no panel.
Style: refined dyed Japanese washi paper with subtle real paper fibers and soft mottled hand-brushed pigments, decorated with a few broad, airy Japanese Momoyama folding-screen-inspired kumo/kasumi cloud shapes. Low contrast but clearly recognizable as clouds when reduced to a 300-pixel square; NOT nearly plain solid color. Graceful elongated horizontal cloud bands with gently scalloped hand-painted contours, modest muted warm gold contour accents, irregular mineral pigment variations inside cloud shapes. Quiet, restrained, refined historical-art-inspired graphic surface, no 3D gloss.
Palette for Takeda game color: muted vermilion / dusty red paper, with pale warm peach-red open areas and deeper subdued burnt-rose cloud bands. Approximately base #E9C8BE, deepest cloud tone #B97D70; delicate aged warm gold accents. Keep the whole background light enough for dark black text.
Composition: same edge-to-edge square sheet, top-down orthographic. The top one sixth and right one sixth should be quiet light paper with only a trace of ornament; they will receive the UI title and data. Place the most distinctive broad cloud silhouettes along the leftmost one sixth (below the top margin) and along the bottom one sixth (left of the right margin), with a few soft curves drifting into the center. Several open pale spaces; clouds occupy about 35 percent of the sheet. Middle region lightly textured and calm. No circular symbols, no family crest. Flat cut texture, no drop shadow, no torn/rolled/curling paper, no page photographed on a table. Square 1200x1200 if supported. Return only the texture image.

Use case: lighting-weather palette edit of a UI background texture. Edit the reference texture as ONE square flat background. Keep the exact cloud shapes, positions, scale and overall open areas of the reference, preserve washi fibers and delicate hand-painted irregular outlines. Change ONLY its palette to: HOJO BLUE. Cool pale mist-blue washi paper #D6E3EC with muted indigo / slate-blue cloud shapes #8EAABD. Tiny contour accents cool pale platinum-gray rather than yellow. Absolutely no pink, red, orange or warm peach cast. Reduce mottled distress and speckling slightly for an elegant quiet paper surface. Still visibly patterned, not plain color. No new motifs. No text, numbers, soldiers, figures, weapons, scene, frame, border, grid, arrow, symbol or crest. Keep top one-sixth and right one-sixth quiet, flat, open and light for later typography. Square edge-to-edge digital texture, no mockup, no shadow.
